import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    # Standardize categorical labels
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip().replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].str.strip().str.lower()
    # Ensure body mass is numeric and mark out-of-range values as missing
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned = clean(df)
    valid = cleaned.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    means = valid.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().round(2)
    return means.to_dict()
